rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an intervening episode or side event, especially figuratively.

example.english: This little interlude actually made the whole thing more memorable.
example.traditional: 呢段小插曲，反而令成件事更加難忘。
example.jyutping: ne1 dyun6 siu2 caap3 kuk1 faan2 ji4 ling6 sing4 gin6 si6 gang3 gaa1 naan4 mong4

rows.note: Use this specifically for a short piece of music placed between sections of a longer composition.

example.english: In the middle of the song, the band played an interlude.
example.traditional: 首歌唱到中間，樂隊先嚟一段間奏。
example.jyutping: sau2 go1 coeng3 dou3 zung1 gaan1 ngok6 deoi2 sin1 lai4 jat1 dyun6 gaan1 zau3

rows.note: Use this specifically for entertainment presented between the acts of a play.

example.english: An interlude was arranged between the two acts so the audience could rest.
example.traditional: 兩幕之間安排幕間節目，供觀眾休息。
example.jyutping: loeng5 mok6 zi1 gaan1 on1 paai4 mok6 gaan1 zit3 muk6 gung1 gun1 zung3 jau1 sik1
